text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh! This sucks! This sucks! This sucks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Tokai Teio comes charging
into my
office in a huff.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I lost to McQueen in the math test by one point. One measly point! Ugh, I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But I'll get her back in tomorrow's sports
science
test! I better start cramming now!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: To the library, duh! C'mon, hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Okay, the textbook should be around
he—wait...
McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You've got the book...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What, this? I'm about to borrow it. Does
that
bother you for some reason?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it does! It bothers me a whole lot!
First off—

text_block_list.name: Library Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, please keep it down while
you're in
the library.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh... sorry. Right. Gotta use my quiet
voice.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
See, the way it works is, I had my eyes
on that
book first, so I get to borrow it
first!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
These books are property of the
academy, are they not? If you need this
one, then why don't we
have a look at it
together?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's, uh... not really what I had in
mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, then I do not understand. Shall I
assume you
have no issue with me
borrowing this book?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm telling you not to do that! Because I have to—

text_block_list.name: Library Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Didn't I just remind you to keep it
down?

text_block_list.name: Library Staff
text_block_list.text:
I won't have you disturbing the other
visitors. The
both of you are banned
from the library for the
rest of the day!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No waaay!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must leave as well?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume of the prestigious
Mejiro family,
barred from entering the
library...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this shame will forever stain our
legacy...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grrr... Gah!
choice_data_list: I got a bit too stubborn.
We got a bit too stubborn, didn't we.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it. When it's McQueen I'm up

against...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I just can't allow myself to lose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Teio...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whatever am I to do with you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hrnghhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Look at you. How long do you intend to
stand
around moping? Shall we consider
this match of
ours over?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! This isn't over!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But... now that the library's out of
bounds, I'm
gonna need somewhere else
to study...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! I know! Hey, Trainer! Lend me
your
office, will you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd say that! That's my trainer
for ya! ♪
All right, let's go, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You want me to come with you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the amicable duo begin their
studies... Or
at least they try to.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? You're still on that same
question? You
know I'm already three
down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Enough out of you! I cannot concentrate!
This is
not a race, so speed should have
no say in the
matter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They won't get any useful studying done
at this
rate. I should step in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They won't get any useful studying done
at this
rate. I should step in.

If you want to see who's better th...
If you want to see who's better th...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh, sounds good! Let's start right now!
choice_data_list: Let's quiz each other and see who ...
If you want to see who's better th...
If you want to see who's better th...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What is the term for the energy exerted
on your
legs when they make contact
with the ground
while running?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Energy... it must be "ground reaction
force"!
Hehe, this is nothing for me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grr... Correct.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, I suppose it would be my turn. On
the
subject of ground reaction force and
its point of
contact...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two become locked in a long battle.
The next day, I hear that the match
ended in a draw, with
both of them
getting perfect scores.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice idea! The books can wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us end this petty rivalry and
set the
record straight once and for all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer, I'll be back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I hear that both of their
track times improved considerably. Their
test results,
however, were
unsatisfactory.
